detail.longDescription: MIT researchers have created a multimodal AI model that understands crystalline materials in 3D, combining atomic structures with natural language to help identify optimal materials for applications like solid-state batteries. The system outperformed text-only models by learning geometric representations. https:// news.mit.edu/2026/giving-ai-cr ystal-clear-view-of-materials-world-1018 # AIagent # AI # GenAI # Research
